cannedReplies.pattern: ^sections$
cannedReplies.reply:
Ask me about any of these and I'll summarize it and scroll you there:
• About
• Projects
• Skills
• Education
• Contact

You can also name a project directly, e.g. "tell me about MealMatch".

cannedReplies.pattern: ^actions$
cannedReplies.reply:
Things I can actually do, not just talk about:
• Open GitHub, LinkedIn, or any social link
• Open a project's code - "open MealMatch"
• Filter projects by category - "show ML projects"
• List every project, or find ones using a specific tech - "projects using Python"
• Fill out the contact form for you
• Copy the email address or this page's link
• Request the CV
• Switch light/dark mode
• Pause or resume animations
• Launch your browser's hidden game - "I'm bored"
• Scroll back to top
• "Surprise me" with a random project
• "Restart" to clear this chat

cannedReplies.pattern: ^fun stuff$
cannedReplies.reply:
I've got a good few easter eggs hiding in here 👀
Try asking if I'm sentient, for a joke (or two), or poking at pop culture (matrix, angels & devils, ancient quests...).
There's some tech trivia buried in here too - status codes, database horror stories, the usual nerd bait.
Some need finding rather than asking - keep an eye on your keyboard.
